description: View Service (WMS) for Road Transport Networks is a dataset listed in Paikkatietohakemisto, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by julkinen.vayla.fi. FTIA INSPIRE View Service (WMS) for Road Transport Networks is an INSPIRE compliant. It contains the following INSPIRE feature type: Road transport network. The service is based on the FTIA INSPIRE Transport Networks Theme Dataset. The dataset is administrated by the Finnish Transport Infrastructure Agency. Coverage: FI. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-paikkatietohakemisto.
